core_obligations: Choose the data representing the two localized classes and reduce to a common proper morphism b : W -> P^1_X by taking W to be the closure of the graph of the isomorphism between the two inverse images of A^1_X (proof lines 11566-11592).

Record the normalised situation and express c_p(Z_i -> X, F_i) and P_p(Z_i -> X, F_i) through E_i, Q_i and C, then apply the same description to Q_1 otimes^L Q_2 over E_1 cap E_2 (proof lines 11594-11632).

Expand c'_p(Q|_{E_1 cap E_2}) and P'_p(Q|_{E_1 cap E_2}) with Lemma labelled lemma-silly-tensor-product and replace polynomials in the restricted classes by the unrestricted ones using Lemma labelled lemma-homomorphism-final (proof lines 11634-11638).
proof_roadmap: Build the common blowing up via the graph closure (proof lines 11566-11592).
Rewrite both sides in the normalised situation (proof lines 11594-11618).
Identify the class of the tensor product over E_1 cap E_2 (proof lines 11620-11632).
Expand and pass from restricted to unrestricted classes (proof lines 11634-11638).
difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-setup, for closed subschemes Z_1, Z_2 of X locally of finite type over S and perfect objects F_i with F_i zero off Z_i and satisfying assumption (3) of Situation labelled situation-loc-chern, the lemma with r_i = P_0(Z_i -> X, F_i) computes c_1 and c_2 of F_1 otimes^L F_2 on Z_1 cap Z_2 as the universal polynomials r_1 c_1(F_2) + r_2 c_1(F_1) and r_1 c_2(F_2) + r_2 c_2(F_1) + C(r_1,2) c_1(F_2)^2 + (r_1 r_2 - 1) c_1(F_1) c_1(F_2) + C(r_2,2) c_1(F_1)^2, together with the corresponding statements for the total Chern character and for P_p (statement lines 11524-11564). The proof first chooses the data b_i : W_i -> P^1_X with Q_i and T_i representing the localized classes, builds a common W as the closure of the graph of the isomorphism between b_1^{-1}(A^1_X) and b_2^{-1}(A^1_X), and uses Lemma labelled lemma-independent-loc-chern-bQ to replace both b_i by the common b with the pullbacks Lg_i^*Q_i (proof lines 11566-11592). It then records the resulting normalised situation (b an isomorphism over A^1_X, E_i the inverse image of Z_i, Q_i with the stated properties) and writes both c_p(Z_i -> X, F_i) and P_p(Z_i -> X, F_i) as (E_i -> Z_i)_* o c'_p(Q_i|_{E_i}) o C via the same lemma (proof lines 11594-11618). Since Q_1 otimes^L Q_2 satisfies the corresponding conditions for F_1 otimes^L F_2 with T_1 cup T_2, the same description applies on E_1 cap E_2, and Lemma labelled lemma-silly-tensor-product expands c'_p(Q|_{E_1 cap E_2}) and P'_p(Q|_{E_1 cap E_2}) in terms of the summands, after which Lemma labelled lemma-homomorphism-final turns polynomials in the restricted classes into polynomials in the unrestricted ones (proof lines 11620-11638). Reducing to a common blowing up through the graph closure and then transporting the polynomial identity from E_1 cap E_2 back to Z_1 cap Z_2 is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
